relevance_scale.2: directly relevant (the headnote chunk directly stating the legal point asked about)

methodology: Every target verified by directly reading the actual chunk's canonical_text from var/rag/caselaw_chunked/*.json. Single-grade (2 only), representative not exhaustive -- as found in prior work on this corpus (evaluation/results/full_corpus_retrieval_audit), a single legal point is often restated across multiple chunks of the same case (headnote index vs. judgment body); only one verified chunk per query is named here.
